central_question.scope_sentence: Exploratory development result on already-opened DEV_REPORT data; the composition was fixed after its components' DEV_REPORT results were public, so error rates are nominal; conditional on the two fitted seed pairs (shared people, not independent samples), the frozen defense models and the fitted readers, in the unweighted DEV_REPORT household superpopulation; not confirmation; source labels unchanged.
